model_choice: Standard p-median with explicit assignment variables (N + N^2 variables). For N=25, this yields 650 variables, well within the CGA backend's ~1500 variable quality threshold. Direct mapping preserves exact specification without auxiliary variables. Assignment variables are treated as helpers with empty keys as they are indexed by the same set twice.

prep.notes: Filtered MSOAs to Camden (E02003 prefix), joined 2021 Census population using prep.match, converted OS coordinates to WGS84, computed straight-line distance matrix in meters.
